what_was_run: canonical/tools/repeated_change_one_example_measure_v1.py on the 15 pull requests and 89 files of REPEATED_CHANGE_ONE_EXAMPLE_20261112_V1.json, refetched from their named commits and hash-checked (15 pull requests, 89 files, all as recorded), plus two hand-run probes of how the organ applies a rule to another construct and to re-worded code.

wording_control.method: Every (example, target) pair of the corpus run twice: once untouched, once with the same change re-worded on BOTH sides (assertEquals->assertEqual, self.assertEqual->self.assert_equal, six.moves.xrange->six.moves.range, logger.warn->log.warn, warnings.warn->warn, utcnow->utc_now).
wording_control.reading: The SAME change under different wording still recovers 332 of the developers' changes. A lookup system recovers zero here. What falls is 5.46 pp of precision-of-fit, not the ability to transfer.

shown_on_an_if_then_target_has_if_while_.reading: it changed all three block positions, not only the if

shown_in_one_function_body_target_has_tw.reading: it changed the matching body and left the other

shown_once_target_has_three_identical_si.reading: it scales with the number of matching sites

counting_across_constructs.reading: The organ learns the CONTENT of the change ('this statement becomes that statement') and applies it to every position of that shape. It is not stuck on the construct it was shown in, and it counts.

what_the_cross_kind_arm_proves: 0 of 4,444 changes, and all 19 of the 19 changes it attempted were not the developers'. That is where the real limiting factor is: the organ has no abstraction that survives a change of KIND. It adapts within a kind and one file over, and it dies across kinds.

why_weights_are_not_available_here.the_sentence: 'A general-purpose pretrained model acting as reasoner/planner/agent is not made admissible by storing its weights inside Brain.' and 'The prohibition is identity- and hosting-independent. It applies equally to ... open-weight models, copied or vendored weights ... and models invoked through runtimes such as llama.cpp, vLLM, Ollama, transformers.'
why_weights_are_not_available_here.consequence: Brain capability, benchmark, acceptance, ownership, promotion and terminal credit are all zero.
why_weights_are_not_available_here.gate: the V22 pre-write admission requires producer_cognition_model_dependency_count == 0

why_weights_are_not_possible_here.host: 2 CPU cores, 3 GB RAM, no CUDA, no GPU, no torch
why_weights_are_not_possible_here.ascent_needs: a frozen teacher's full next-token distributions along a verified trajectory, distilled into LoRA fast weights -- an open-weight base model and a GPU
why_weights_are_not_possible_here.experience_distillation_needs: 749 curated SWE tasks of rollout plus teacher sampling at every history step
why_weights_are_not_possible_here.consequence: No number produced here could be a measurement. It could only be a fabrication, which the mission's fail-closed truth rule forbids more strictly than it forbids saying no.

the_deeper_point.experience_distillation_own_ablation: on the same experience, direct supervised fine-tuning recovers 3.8% of the in-context gain, and the distillation method recovers 64.8%. The weight layer is downstream of the experience layer: you cannot distil what you never had.
the_deeper_point.therefore: Token-space learning is not a weaker substitute for weight-space learning. It is the raw material the weight layer distils. Improving it is not a detour from the path to weights; it is the path.
the_deeper_point.forgetting: Full fine-tuning shows ~89% forgetting on prior tasks, LoRA ~71% in some settings, sparse memory layers ~11%. The same experience kept as an inspectable, deletable artifact forgets nothing.

real: 29.45% of the developers' non-import changes recovered from ONE demonstration, permanently
generalises to another file of the same kind: that is the whole measurement
adapts to different wording of the same change: 332 changes after re-wording
counts across constructs: if, while and def all changed from one showing
not_real: that the system is a limited lookup system: a lookup system recovers 0 after re-wording, this recovers 332
that it cannot count different things: probed, it counts and it crosses constructs
that it cannot work on different files: every one of the 440 askings is a different file
that weight-space learning would be either legal or possible here, today, at zero credit

limits: 8 kinds of change, 2 pull requests each: a per-kind number has n=2 and is not a rate.
Python only. The cross-kind arm is 4,444 changes and its zero is a real zero, not a small number.
The re-wording probe re-words with a fixed list of substitutions; it is one treatment, not a distribution over wordings.
